assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: All parcel actions, road alignments, municipal capacities and statutory indicators remain conceptual; the package is eligible for content review with explicit provisional-boundary warnings.

assumptions.statement: Visible human takeover and offline minimum service improve public resilience when AI-dependent services fail.
assumptions.impact: The three stations and twelve nodes must be tested with residents, frontline workers and professional teams before implementation.
